metadata.title: Vintage Soul Vinyl Cover Aesthetic
useCases: Album art for retro soul or R&B

retrievalProfile.description: A weathered 1970s soul album aesthetic featuring heavy slab-serif display type and interlocking geometric symbols on a dark, distressed background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, heavily textured square composition featuring bold, two-tone slab-serif typography at the top and large, interlocking pink and blue gender symbols centered in the lower two-thirds.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic block balanced by large central iconography
Interlocking circles creating a focal point of intersection
High-contrast color palette against a dark, weathered field
Repetition of pink and blue across both text and symbols
coreInvariants: Heavy ring-wear and surface scuffing texture across the entire frame
Ultra-bold slab serif display type with minimal letter spacing
Interlocking circular symbols with thick, uniform stroke weights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large interlocking symbols occupy the bottom 60% of the frame; text is stacked in the top 30%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection point of the two large circles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold pink title, moves to the blue artist name, scans the tracklist, and settles on the large central symbols.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured background provides breathing room around the central icons.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background with heavy white/grey distressing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink and cyan-blue for primary elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow and lime green for secondary tracklist text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for primary elements against a low-value, desaturated background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with rectangular serifs and high stroke weight.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning (touching in some areas)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic slab serif for main titles with a smaller, multi-colored sans-serif or slab for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and blocky terminals.
Provides the correct vintage geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark charcoal square background with heavy vintage vinyl ring wear, white scuff marks, and paper aging textures. Center two large interlocking circular symbols (one pink female symbol, one blue male symbol) with thick uniform strokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two rows of large, ultra-bold slab-serif text at the top in magenta and cyan. Below that, add a dense block of smaller tracklist text in alternating colors separated by bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the ring wear texture visible and circular?
Are the slab serifs blocky and heavy?
Is the tracking tight enough that letters nearly touch?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the display text

avoid: Modern digital noise instead of organic scuffs

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture looks like physical paper damage, not digital filters.
Verify the slab serifs are not rounded.
Check that the interlocking symbols are perfectly circular.
Confirm the color palette remains limited to the specified retro tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a dark textured field, apply heavy slab-serif type in high-contrast primary colors at the top, and anchor the bottom with large, thick-stroked geometric icons.
